# Legal Service India

> > India's comprehensive online legal services portal connecting clients with lawyers, legal experts, and resources for consultation, intellectual property registration, and legal education.

Legal Service India is a premier Indian legal portal offering instant online legal advice through chat support, government-approved copyright and patent registration services, extensive legal articles by advocates and experts, and a comprehensive directory of law colleges and legal resources across India.

## Key Topics

- Copyright Law
- Patent Law
- Intellectual Property
- Copyright Registration
- Indian Law
- Copyright Act 1957
- Lawyer Directory
- Legal Articles
- Tax Laws
- Public Interest Litigation
- Supreme Court
- Family Law
- Creative Works Protection
- Copyright Infringement
- Online Legal Consultation

## Core Legal Services

- [Legal Service India - Law, Lawyers and Legal Resources](https://www.legalserviceindia.com): Homepage: Indian legal services portal with lawyer directory and free consultancy
- [Lawyers Chat Online - Online Advice - Instant Legal Advice](https://www.legalserviceindia.com/chat_support.htm): Chat with legal experts online for instant advice via WhatsApp and PayTM
- [Copyright Registration in India | Book, Website, Music, Software - Govt. Approved](https://www.legalserviceindia.com/copyright/Copyright-Registration-in-India.htm): Government-approved copyright registration service for creative works

## Intellectual Property & Copyright

- [Copyright Law in India - Copyright Office, Copyright act](https://www.legalserviceindia.com/article/l195-Copyright-Law-in-India.html): Comprehensive guide to Copyright Act 1957 and registration in India
- [Patent Law in India - Patent Registration Procedure - Patent Lawyers in India](https://www.legalserviceindia.com/cyber/patent-law-India.htm): Patent law guide covering registration procedure and TRIPS Agreement
- [Copyright of Cinematograph Films and Sound Recording - Video, Song, Film](https://www.legalserviceindia.com/copyright/Cinematograph-Films.htm): Guide to copyright registration for films, videos, and sound recordings
- [Music Composers' Copyright Rights in India](https://www.legalserviceindia.com/copyright/music-copyright-in-India.htm): Music composer copyright rights under Copyright Act 1957 with case law
- [Copyright Registration Certificate | Copyright Office, Govt of India](https://www.legalserviceindia.com/copyright/certificate.htm): Copyright certificate samples and Berne Convention reference material
- [Copyright Judgments in India](https://www.legalserviceindia.com/copyright/index.html): Landmark copyright judgment analysis and legal precedents in India
